objective: Load portfolio sections 02 (Career & Leadership), 03 (Selected Works), 04 (TechnicalProficiency), and 05 (Credentials & Education) from data/Career.json, data/Works.json, data/TechnicalProficiency.json, and data/Credentials.json populated with current webpage data and dynamically reflected on edit
constraints: Populate data/Career.json, data/Works.json, data/TechnicalProficiency.json, and data/Credentials.json with the exact current webpage data from src/data/portfolio.ts
Ensure JSON edits dynamically update the rendered webpage via Vite HMR and runtime fetch fallback while preserving file:// compatibility
Maintain TypeScript type safety (tsc --noEmit) and existing EditorialTemplate visual structure
nonGoals: Do not externalize Section 01 (Profile) or Section 06 (Archives/Documents) to JSON files
Do not alter authentication or modal download flows

decisions.question: Which JSON file paths correspond to sections 02 through 05?
decisions.basis: Explicitly specified in the user request and already present as empty files under data/

decisions.question: How should JSON files be loaded so edits dynamically reflect on the webpage while keeping single-file/file:// compatibility?
decisions.answer: Import data/*.json in src/data/portfolio.ts for bundled/HMR reactivity and provide usePortfolioData() with runtime fetch refresh when served over HTTP(S)
decisions.basis: Vite natively hot-reloads imported JSON files during dev/build, and runtime fetch over HTTP(S) refreshes edited JSON files dynamically without breaking file:// fallback

decisions.question: How should Lucide icons for Section 04 (TechnicalProficiency) be represented in JSON?
decisions.answer: Store icon identifier strings ('Layout', 'Server', 'CloudCog') in data/TechnicalProficiency.json and map them to LucideIcon components in src/data/portfolio.ts
decisions.basis: JSON cannot serialize function references; string-to-icon mapping preserves the exact Layout, Server, and CloudCog icons
